## Think About It

1. Who does Kate write a note to? (Her friend Jane.) 2. How does Kate get the note to Jane? (She rides her bike to Jane's home.) 3. What does Jane's note say? ("I am fine! Let us play today!") 4. Find a silent E word. (note, home, write, friend, name, kind, smiles, writes, fine, hope, school, soon, envelope, lane, rides, bike, day, bright, smile, rides, reads, loud, glad.)
